decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 (N600-09, likely 4 h) and LH-05 (E543-11, likely 2 h) are down, so the confirmation rule does not apply. No stope is stopped, so no reserve is activated. About 7 loading hours remain (09:30-11:00 and 11:30-17:00). Truck limits are roughly Norte 66 t/h, Central 104 t/h and Este 72 t/h; these assume a mid-depth cycle of about 0.41, 0.35 and 0.38 h. Norte's stockpile is 242 of 450 t. With LH-01 down, Norte's two working loaders give about 71 t/h, so Norte is already truck-limited. One extra LH410 there (25.4 t/h at 220 m) adds net stockpile of about 190 t, which fits in the 208 t of room. A second extra loader would hit the 450 t cap. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading DS-C538-01, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. It arrives at N600-09 in about 0.65 h and mucks about 6.3 h, roughly 160 t at 0.383 oz/t. That is about +61 oz, less about 1.4 oz of development cost. N600-09 still has 239 t of broken ore, so ore is not the limit. LH-09 stays on the critical-path heading. Its cost of 4.0 oz/h is about equal to its mucking gain of about 6.3 oz/h at E543-11 (23.6 t/h, 0.267 oz/t), so a loan nets about zero. LH-10 finishes preventive maintenance at 11:00 (06:00 start plus 5 h) and has no home production to lose. It reaches E543-11 at about 11:30, when LH-05 is repaired. E543-11 holds 285 t and LH-05 alone can muck only about 182 t. LH-10 adds up to about 100 t, roughly +27 oz, and Este's stockpile (49 of 450 t) has plenty of room. Total is about 85 oz.
